input.brief: BrushStroke Pro, a painting contractor since 2009 transforming interiors and exteriors with cobalt and sand

direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Two prints in darkness
hero.blueprint: One near-black field with a slight colour tint, about 75% of it left empty. Navigation is split between the top corners at 15px on 30px margins: the wordmark and three text links top-left, the single action top-right as the page's one solid light rectangle. Two low-key photographs sit in the dark like lit exhibits, both with square corners and no frame. The larger, a 4:5 portrait about 34% of the viewport wide (columns 6-9), has its top at 14% of the height, so it sits a little above the midline. The smaller, a 1:1 about 12% of the viewport wide (columns 2-3), sits far from it with its top at 52% of the height, dimmed with filter: brightness(0.7) so the large one stays the brightest thing on screen. The headline is modest: two lines at clamp(28px, 2.5vw, 40px) in a regular weight, flush to the bottom-left corner on the 30px margin. Columns 10-12 hold one sentence at 16px in the dimmer ink, bottom-aligned to the headline's last baseline, max 24ch. Nothing else is on screen.
hero.mobile: The large photograph takes 78% of the width, pushed to the right margin, its top at 12% of the height. The small square sits at 30% of the width on the left margin, overlapping the large one's lower-left corner by 24px. The headline sets at 6.4vw on two lines bottom-left with the sentence beneath at 15px. The action is a small solid rectangle top-right; links fold behind a menu word.
hero.headline: A quiet statement of 4-7 words at 28-40px, at most 44 characters on two lines.

type.note: A flat-sided extended grotesk in heavy capitals, wide enough that two words fill the screen, with a neutral sans kept small. Suits portfolios, real estate, travel and brand sites that want a broad, confident wordmark.

palette.name: Graphite and orange
palette.note: Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate, graphite taking about two thirds, and photographs are desaturated so nothing competes. Safety orange marks the buttons, one thick solid bar across the top of the page and the highlighted item in a list or chart.

photos.title: Architecture
photos.note: structure, lines, bridges, facades and building interiors
photos.treatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
sections.blueprint: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
sections.mobile: The paragraph comes first at 22px, full width with 20px margins and no indent. The photograph follows at 62% width, pushed to the right margin, in a 4:5 crop instead of square. The small note sits to its left, bottom-aligned with the photograph, in the remaining 30% of the width.

sections.name: Big names, fixed preview
sections.blueprint: Project names are the index. In columns 1–8, five to nine names stack one per line at clamp(44px, 5.4vw, 80px), leading 1.0, each row a link with 10px of vertical padding. All names rest in the ink at 35% opacity except the active one, which is full ink; the first is active by default, and hover or keyboard focus moves the state. To the right of each name, on its baseline at 14px: the discipline and the year. In columns 9–12 a `position: sticky; top: 15vh` frame, 4:5 and 26vw wide with square corners, shows the active project's photograph; all images are stacked in the frame and swapped by opacity over 200ms. A two-word heading at 28px sits top-left, 48px above the first name. Nothing is drawn between rows: the size of the type and the dimming do the separating.
sections.mobile: Names at 9.5vw, all in full ink, one per line; discipline and year sit beneath each name at 13px. There is no sticky frame: each name is preceded by its own photograph at 16:10, full width, so the list becomes image then name, repeated, with 40px between projects.

sections.name: One scene, stepping statements
sections.blueprint: A wrapper 350–450vh tall holds a sticky full-bleed photograph (100vw by 100svh) with a calm, symmetrical subject and a clear upper third; a neutral dark scrim covers only that upper third. At top centre, five or six short statements of two to five words are stacked at 18–20px with 10px between them; the first of them is the section's heading. One statement is at full white and the rest at 45% opacity; the active line steps down the stack as the reader scrolls (IntersectionObserver on invisible 70vh markers). For each statement, two small photographs with square corners, 160–240px wide and of different ratios, fade in left and right of the centre line at different heights, then leave when the next pair arrives. No other text. A low-key image on a deep ground works equally well.
sections.mobile: The photograph stays sticky at 100svh, cropped to its centre. The statement stack moves to the bottom third over a scrim, at 17px, left-aligned on the margin. Each statement brings one small photograph only, 44vw wide, placed in the top-right corner with a 16px margin.

sections.name: Lead quote, corner quotes
sections.blueprint: A single field one viewport tall (min-height 100svh), usually the darkest tone of the palette. The lead quotation sits in the upper third: two lines at about 4vw in a light weight, centred, no wider than 60% of the viewport, with nothing near it. Two further short quotations are pushed into the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, each a block three columns wide set at 16px with leading 1.5, left-aligned, with the speaker's name and role on the two lines beneath in the softer ink. The bottom centre, about six columns wide, is deliberately empty. Use a three-row grid (auto 1fr auto) so the corner blocks hold a bottom margin of 32px while the lead quotation keeps its place at any height. There is no heading and there are no portraits; the contrast between one large voice and two small ones is the composition.
sections.mobile: The lead quotation moves to the top at 8vw over three or four lines, left-aligned, with 96px of empty field under it. The two small quotations then stack at 16px, the first full width, the second indented by a quarter of the screen so they do not read as a list.

sections.name: Names as one sentence
sections.blueprint: Client, press or partner names are written out as one run-on sentence and set large: clamp(40px, 5vw, 76px), leading 1.0, flush left across all twelve columns, wrapping naturally over five to seven lines. Names are separated by commas and the list ends with a full stop. All names are set in a dimmed ink (still at least 3:1 against the ground), so the block reads as texture; one name at a time is lit in the full ink, and the lit name moves through the list every two seconds (a class toggled by a short script, with a 400ms colour transition). The sentence opens with two or three plain words in the full ink that act as the heading: the phrase that introduces the names. Nothing else is in the section: no logos, no columns, and 120px of space above and below.
sections.mobile: The same sentence at 9vw, wrapping over ten to fourteen lines; cut the list to the twelve strongest names so it stays within one and a half screens. The lit name still cycles. Margins are 20px and there are no other elements.

sections.name: The object returns
sections.blueprint: The thing shown in the hero comes back once, from another angle, to close the page. On one flat field 90svh tall, the object's photograph occupies columns 1–8, scaled to about 130% of that area and anchored so the section's bottom and left edges crop it (`overflow: hidden` on the section; on light fields `mix-blend-mode: multiply` removes a white studio background). The text sits small in columns 10–12, vertically centred: a closing line of three to five words at 32–40px, one sentence at 17px, the price or key fact on its own line at 22px, and one rectangular button. Nothing overlaps the object's focal area. Where the page's subject is a shape rather than a photograph, the page's motif takes the object's place at the same scale as a flat filled shape. The closing line is the only heading.
sections.mobile: The text block comes first: closing line at 28px, sentence, fact, full-width button. The object follows at 130% of the screen width, shifted so the right and bottom edges crop it, filling about 55svh on the same flat field.

sections.name: A single quiet line
sections.blueprint: No footer block at all. After at least 30svh of empty page ground, one baseline 30px above the bottom edge carries three items in the page's ordinary small text size (14–16px), the same size and weight as the navigation: at the left margin, what this is in three or four words; centred, two to five links separated by 24px of space; at the right margin, the year and a privacy link. Use a three-column grid (1fr auto 1fr) so the centre group is truly centred whatever the side lengths. No logo, no background change, no line above it, no columns. Links are in the full ink; the rest in the softer ink. If the page has a narrow text column, the three items may instead sit on that column's left edge as one wrapped line. The restraint only works if the page above has already made its invitation.
sections.mobile: Three short lines at 14px on the left margin with 8px between them: the description, the links on one wrapped line, then year and privacy. Links stay in the full ink. Leave 20svh of empty ground above and 24px below.

references.name: Moto Finance
references.idea: A metal card presented like a museum piece: lit by a single overhead light box in a black room, then orbiting through dim architectural stills.
references.hero: Black full-bleed 3D scene. A pale silver-lavender light panel, a trapezoid in perspective like a ceiling light box, occupies the top 20% and centre 55% of the viewport. The two-line uppercase headline, centred at 4.4vw in medium grotesk with tight leading, straddles the panel's lower edge so its first line sits half on light, half on black. In the exact centre a small metal card stands on a low plinth, only about 150px wide, surrounded by darkness. A light-grey pill button (about 250 by 52px) is centred near the bottom; the logo is top-left and a dark pill button top-right.
references.type: Neue Montreal only: weight 500 uppercase at 64px (4.4vw) with near-zero tracking and leading under 1.0 for headings, 20px sentence case for body, tiny caps labels in the footer. Three sizes; centred until the left-aligned footer.
references.colour: #080808 #edefef #c4cbd6 #e1e5e5 #2a2f3a — Black with cool silver-grey and no brand colour at all. One section inverts to pale grey-white with grey type; the only chroma is amber city lights and a blue atmosphere rim on the globe.
references.imagery: Rendered chrome card with an embossed profile medallion, a night-side Earth, and small dim architectural and fashion stills floating as tilted panels in 3D. Everything underexposed, cool and low-saturation.
references.layout: Full-viewport scenes stacked one per screen, each with a centred uppercase heading, an optional short sub-line and a pill button. One light interlude breaks the black. The footer switches to a left-aligned statement with link columns at the far right.

sections.description: Centred heading at the top with a two-line grey sub-line and a pale pill button directly under it. The lower 45% is the top arc of a night-side Earth rising from the bottom edge, about 75% of the viewport wide, with city lights and a bright blue-white rim on the upper right. Three small dark capsule labels with check icons float over and beside the globe at staggered positions, like status notifications.

A dark 3D room: about twelve small photo panels (roughly 70 by 90px, each tilted at its own angle, heavily dimmed) arranged in two loose rows across the full width, receding with blur. The card stands edge-on in the centre, much larger, catching a specular highlight. Later the card faces front at top-centre and a centred two-line heading with a pill button sits under it.

A pale grey-white band. Two tall columns of currency amounts in mid-size light-grey sans, one at a quarter and one at three-quarters of the width, each fading to white at top and bottom like slot-machine reels, with the centre rows darkest. Between them, three short centred lines of small black text. The bottom edge of the band reveals a dark photograph.

steal: Let a headline straddle the edge of a light shape so one line is half on light and half on dark.
Show the product very small in a large dark space in the first viewport, then let it grow as the page scrolls.
Use vertically scrolling columns of real-looking figures, faded at both ends, as a quiet backdrop for a three-line statement.
references.media: An 11s hero video of a CG metal card on a plinth covers the whole first screen and holds on its last frame. Then a pinned WebGL globe in the lower half under centred text, a 3D card centred in a depth cloud of small photo tiles dimmed to 30-40%, full-bleed sticky photographs with text docked in opposite corners, and a photo strip sitting on an index list; all low-key and desaturated, photos meeting the near-black ground through 200-300px fades, 0px radius.
references.motion: The intro ends in about 1.2s as the camera pushes in and the headline, nav and button arrive (load 9.9s), and Lenis then runs 32 ScrollTriggers: the globe pins for 2.5 viewports at scrub 1, the card turns in 3D across its section, the theme inverts to pale grey with the nav colour following, and benefit rows scrub in one by one. Lines rise by yPercent over 0.65s power3.out and leave over 0.45s power2.in, and headings rise from a blur over 1s power2.inOut.

references.name: IZANAMI
references.idea: Silence as design: one small sentence in fog, then a slow descent from mist into a dark glass pavilion.
references.hero: After a warm-black loader showing only one 18px serif sentence and a small counter, the hero is a full-bleed, desaturated grey-green image of pine forest dissolving into fog. The same sentence stays at 18px in white, left-aligned on a line about 17% from the left edge and exactly at vertical centre; it is the only text in the picture area. A small white seal-style logo sits top-left; a language switch and menu label in tiny tracked capitals sit top-right, each with a dot above. Along the bottom edge: copyright, two live city clocks, and a scroll cue at far right, all near 10px.
references.type: Playfair Display regular for the few headings, only 18 to 45px (3.1vw at most); Shippori Mincho for body at 14px; Cinzel capitals with wide tracking for nav, clocks and footer. Nothing is large: hierarchy comes from isolation rather than size.
references.colour: #0a0801 #6f7a70 #b7b5a6 #d9d2c3 #4b5b39 — Warm near-black panels and grey-green fog imagery with off-white text at reduced opacity. Moss green and sand from the small garden photos are the only colour; there is no accent.
references.imagery: Fog-bound forest, a black-framed glass pavilion seen in one-point perspective, and small crops of incense smoke, a bamboo water spout and raked gravel. Small images are square-cornered, portrait or square, overlapping one another and the dark ceiling plane.
references.layout: Wide margins, with text hung on an inner line about 17% across instead of the page edge. Most screens hold one image and one short text; small photos are placed asymmetrically near corners and overlap. A rotated section label runs down the left edge.

sections.description: Over the black ceiling of the pavilion image, a three-line serif heading at about 3vw sits left of centre, each line indented further than the one above. Faint body text follows below it. A small square photo sits top-left under the logo; at right, three portrait photos overlap in a cluster, two beige garden shots behind and a narrower green water-ripple image in front and raised higher, running off the bottom edge.

Full-bleed one-point-perspective view down a glass corridor, its ceiling filling the upper half as near-black. A text link with a short leading rule sits top-left on the inner line; a landscape photo of raked gravel is tucked against the top edge right of centre; a three-line heading fades in low and left of centre over the glass. A section name rotated ninety degrees runs down the far left.

Near-black and almost empty. One section name in serif at about 24px, preceded by a long thin rule, sits at mid-height left of centre. Lower down, tiny tracked-capital columns: a nav list, two office addresses side by side, and social links pushed to the far right. The bottom edge repeats the copyright and the two city clocks.

steal: Place a single 18px sentence at vertical centre on an offset left line over full-bleed fog, and let the absence of a headline be the statement.
Stair-step a three-line heading by indenting each line further than the one above it.
Run two live city clocks with time-zone labels along the bottom edge as quiet proof of where the firm operates.
references.media: A misted forest photograph covers the whole first screen under drifting cloud layers, with text on about 0.2% of the area. Then a pinned full-screen architectural scene dollies forward while overlapping collages of two or three photographs at different widths pass over it, rows pair a text column at about 28vw with a portrait flush to the right margin, and the fog band returns as a bookend; about 11 photographs, one WebGL canvas, no video.
references.motion: A warm near-black screen with the tagline already in place until about 2.5s, then a fog bank creeps in from the lower right and the chrome fades in by 4.5s; load took 7.2s. Lenis with three sticky sections scrubs the scene as the forest darkens and the camera sinks into the pavilion, photographs move at different rates, and headline lines fade in one by one; two cloud layers loop on 100s linear translates, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

references.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
references.idea: Let the renders do the talking: one full-bleed visualisation, a name set half in grotesk and half in serif, then alternating oversized sans and serif statements on white.
references.hero: A single architectural render fills the viewport edge to edge: a low grey metal-clad building under a large overcast sky, wild grass across the bottom third. Type is white and tiny except for the name. Top-left at a 24px margin, the bureau name is stacked on three lines at 13px. Top-right, four links run inline separated by commas, the current one underlined. Bottom-left, the name repeats at 60px (4.2vw) on two tight lines, the first two words in grotesk and the last word in a serif at the same size. No button, no scrim, no tagline; the sky takes the upper 45% untouched.
references.type: Two faces (digest names are obfuscated): a tight neo-grotesk at −0.03em and a soft high-contrast serif, mixed inside one line in the name. Section statements alternate: centred sans at about 6.5vw, then left-aligned serif at 4.5vw with a first-line indent. Labels are 9px.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #b7b7b9 #7c8050 #3d3a36 #9a9a9a — White pages with black type; colour comes only from the renders' overcast greys, greens and dark timber. The footer inverts to solid black with white letters.
references.imagery: Photoreal architectural visualisations in muted natural light, shown full-bleed at wide panoramic crops with square corners and no overlays; one loose black ink sketch on white stands in for process.
references.layout: 24px outer margins. Full-bleed image bands alternate with white type-only screens. Big statements either centre or run the full width; small data sits in narrow columns with tiny serif labels left of sans values, and hairline tables are inset to the right-hand third.

sections.description: White screen with a two-line sans heading centred at roughly 6.5vw, tight leading, taking the top third. Directly beneath, two tiny grey captions of two lines each sit side by side, each about 130px wide, centred as a pair. A full-bleed panoramic render starts immediately below and runs off the bottom, so the heading reads as a caption to the picture.

Far left, three label and value pairs at 9px (serif label, sans value) stack in a 150px column. From 34% across, a five-line serif paragraph at about 22px runs to 90% of the width. 120px lower a second row repeats the logic for achievements: a label at far left, then two narrow list columns of awards and publications at 9px with generous gaps between them.

A four-line serif statement at 4.5vw spans the full width, left-aligned with the first line indented about 3% and leading under 1. Below it, pushed into the right-hand 35% of the page, an offices table: a tiny label hangs to its left, and each row holds office type, country and city in grey, an address, and a small arrow, divided by hairlines at 18px row height.

Solid black. A top band of five tiny columns (name, navigation, media, address, hours), each a grey label beside a white list. Then a four-letter abbreviation of the name in white grotesk fills the entire width, letters about 45% of the viewport tall and touching both edges, with a single 8px legal line squeezed beneath.

steal: Set the last word of a sans headline in an upright serif of the same size to give a plain name a signature without any graphic device.
Alternate statement voices down the page: a centred grotesk heading, then a full-width left-aligned serif paragraph at display size with a first-line indent.
Close with an abbreviation of the name scaled until it touches both edges of a black footer, with all practical links shrunk to 9px above it.
references.media: One photoreal render covers the whole first screen with only the title docked bottom-left and no scrim. Below: a full-bleed 2:1 band under a centred headline, overscanned 32px per side for parallax, a staggered two-column scatter of landscape and portrait frames at uneven offsets, hand sketches drawn into the white page between statements, and a ring of small rotated square team photographs round a centred headline on black; 27 images and a fixed WebGL layer, no video.
references.motion: A white preloader with a progress line along the top and a counter stalled near 60 for 2.5s; by 4.5s the hero is in and the title rises out of a mask line by line. Lenis over the fixed WebGL layer: sketches build stroke by stroke on a scrub, the ground flips white to black over 0.3s at the values chapter, paragraph lines rise over 0.5s, and team photographs spiral in and settle into a ring; one ease for everything, cubic-bezier(.17,.84,.44,1), 34 uses.
